capabilities: Repair broken ![[...X.resources/file.ext]] links by scanning res_*.resources folders and rewriting links to the best-match folder
Shrink small UI icons in image embeds by appending |48 when filenames match known icon patterns
Strip image embeds nested inside markdown link text on the current selection
Run all fixes on the current note with a single auto-fix command
extras: The repair command is destructive (rewrites note content) and the author recommends backing up first. Mobile is untested even though isDesktopOnly is false. Install is manual only (download main.js and manifest.json from releases).
problem: Notes imported from web clippers like Evernote arrive with broken resource-folder links and 200+ px favicons, avatars, and tracking pixels cluttering the note body, with no built-in way to fix them.
summary: Cleanup tool for web-clipped imports that repairs broken _resources links and shrinks oversized favicons, avatars, and UI icons in notes.
